skills.line: Slow down. I can tell you the stories of Mt. Suzuka all night.

skills.name: Hillcry: Slash (麓鸣·斬/麓鳴・斬)
skills.description:
Advanced secret of the Jade Blade of Yasakani. Ootakemaru unleashes a crashing wave of energy at a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. Damage from this attack will not trigger enemy passives or souls. He also gains a 50% to Assist.
100% of the damage dealt with Hillcry: Slash will be added to the next damage dealt by Rock Fall from Unlimited Sword Prison (cannot exceed 600% of Ootakemaru's ATK).
;Assist
:When an ally uses a normal attack to attack an enemy, will also use normal attack to attack the same target.

skills.line: My shelter is what made me strong.

Ootakemaru conjures Force of Earth to protect himself at the end of his turn and it lasts until the start of his next turn.
Force of Earth breaks after taking 2 attacks. ;Force of Earth (覆土の力) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Reduce damage taken by 20%.

skills.name: Unlimited Blade Prison (无尽剑狱/無尽剣獄)
skills.description:
Ootakemaru uses Unlimited Blade Prison to Banish an enemy, gains 30% of the target's inital ATK and DEF (the gained stats cannot exceed 50% of Otakemaru's own initial ATK and DEF) until the end of his next turn. Then he conjures a devastating Wave of Rocks to attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 285% of his ATK. When the Blade Prison closes, the floating Rock Falls on the Banished enemy, dealing damage equal to 358% of his ATK. This damage cannot be shared, does not trigger the enemy's passive or souls and increases Ootakemaru's move bar by 40% and removes extra stats gained.
When Unlimited Blade Prison is in effect, this skill cannot be used. ;Unlimited Blade Prison (無限剣獄) :'''Debuff, Mark''': Decreases damage dealt by the Wave of Rocks by 10% for each enemy it attacks. Blade Prison ends immediately when Ootakemaru or ally other enemies are KO'd.
If there is only 1 enemy when using this skill or the enemy is immune to control effects, the Blade Prison cannot be created. Damage dealt by the Wave of Rocks is doubled instead.

upgrades.text: Damage for the Wave of Rocks increases to 299%.
Damage for the Wave of Rocks increases to 312%.
When Blade Prison closes, raises Move Bar by 70%.
12% of the total damage dealt by the Wave of Rocks is added to Rock Fall's damage (cannot exceed 600% of Ootakemaru's ATK).
